differences.what: A module, exam_neuro_2, that the General note type includes: its section Neurologic: strength, sensation, coordination, reflexes and gait shows only while Neurologic (exam.systems is neurologic) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal. Neurologic is two modules, one for each piece; exam_neuro_1 is the other.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory section 7 (pieces 12 and 13), default 10

differences.what: Motor Strength is a grid, Motor strength, with the rows Upper extremity and Lower extremity (added), recorded for the right and the left (sides): the four bullets are its four cells. Each cell is a whole number from 0 to 5, shown out of 5. Normal fills 5.
differences.why: PRD main 414 (left and right where it matters); focused-exam inventory default 28, 44; forms 6.3

differences.what: Sensory is choose-many. Intact is the normal option and clears the others.

Location: Select body region is a region, Location, from the shared list body_region (Head, Upper Body, Abdomen, Back, Arms, Legs, Lower Body, Hands, added), with a side from the shared list side (Right, Left, Bilateral, added), shown only while a finding other than Intact is picked. Normal leaves it empty.
differences.why: PRD main 410, 414; focused-exam inventory default 37; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the side of a sensory finding is this plan's, the line gives none

differences.what: Coordination is choose-many. Normal fills Finger-to-nose normal and Heel-to-shin normal, so neither is exclusive. Unable is neither normal nor abnormal, and clears the others. Abnormal may be held with one normal option (the other test was abnormal); held with both it contradicts itself, which a pair of excludes cannot refuse.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory 3.7, default 13, 26; forms 2.2 (unable); PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): Abnormal beside both normal options

differences.what: Reflexes is a grid, collapsed until tapped, with a row for each reflex (Biceps, Triceps, Patellar, Achilles, added: the check reads a plain line as no word), recorded for the right and the left (sides), each cell choose-one from the shared list reflex_scale: 0, 1+, 2+, 3+, 4+ (added: the scale line is no word). The table is optional, so Normal leaves it empty, as it does every collapsed part: the scale's normal 2+ is filled only by hand.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory construct 26, default 25, 28 (one-tap Normal leaves an optional part alone)

differences.what: The table's heading row (Reflex, Grade) is not typed: Grade is the cell's label.
Gait is choose-many. Normal is the normal option and clears the others. Unable is neither normal nor abnormal, and clears the others.
